    Egypt Stock Market Daily Summary – May 13, 2025

    • Mohamed Jaafar
    • May 13, 2025
    • 1 min read
    The Egyptian Exchange (EGX) closed higher on Tuesday 13.05.25, supported by broad-based gains across major indices and strong buying by Arab investors.



    Egypt Stock Market Daily Ssummary Overview

    • EGX30: +0.37% to 31,692.77 points

    • EGX70 EWI: +0.28% to 9,462.02 points

    • EGX100 EWI: +0.34% to 12,811.15 points

    • Market Capitalization: EGP 2.25 trillion



    Investor Activity:

    • Arab investors: Net buyers with EGP 3.81 billion in inflows

    • Egyptian investors: Net sellers, offloading EGP 3.56 billion

    • Non-Arab foreign investors: Net sellers, offloading EGP 251 million


    📊 Technical Analysis – EGX30


    • Technical Summary: Neutral

    • Moving Averages: Buy signals (8 buy vs. 4 sell)

    • Technical Indicators: Sell signals (4 sell)

    📉Fundamental Insights


    • Market P/E Ratio: 6.5x, below the 3-year average of 7.6x, indicating potential undervaluation

    • Earnings Growth: Listed companies have experienced a 55% annual earnings growth over the past three years

    • Revenue Growth: Revenues have grown 41% annually



    Sector Highlights:

    • Utilities: Favored by investors, trading near a 3-year average P/E of 22.8x

    • Energy: Least preferred, trading near a 3-year average P/E of 3.7x

    • Real Estate: Analysts expect annual earnings growth of 27% over the next five years

    • Materials: Expected to see earnings decline by 3.9% annually
